agentRequirements: You must be running version 10.1.x or higher.

You must be in a supported AWS region to use Agent Mode. See the supported regions listed in the next section. Splunk Enterprise customers who install Splunk AI Assistant through the Cloud Connected option must select a supported region at the time of installation. To change your region you must redo the installation process. Cloud Connected customers also lose Context data if they change regions. It can take up to 2 weeks to build back this knowledge repository.

Model Runtime must be turned on to use Agent Mode. On the Settings page and General tab, turn on Model Runtime by selecting "Let Splunk determine the best model to deliver the outcome based on your prompt (this may include models hosted outside Splunk Cloud Platform)".
